signals.text: 'He's unavailable' - Moyes tight-lipped on Grealish. Everton manager David Moyes' post-match reaction to his side's one-goal win against struggling Newcastle United, as well as the availability of Jack Grealish following disciplinary action.
Who produced the kind of performance Moyes loves? - player ratings. Newcastle United and Everton's players rated following their Premier League match.
Celtic track teenager Doumbia - gossip. Celtic monitor Ivory Coast teenager playing in Sweden as one of their Europa League opponents seek a new manager.
